body:
Question stem:
Answer the following question. Submit one photograph showing your constructed graph and your written response together.

Stimulus:
A researcher records the number of days until germination for 23 seeds of the same species under identical conditions. Construct a dot plot on a scale covering 2 through 9 days, and describe the shape and noteworthy features of the distribution.

| Days to germinate | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 | 8 | 9 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Number of seeds | 3 | 5 | 6 | 4 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
